_note: Settings for the offline course packages. The package build makes one zip per entry in packages, named <slug>-<package id>-v<course version>.zip. Drive folders are found by the code at the start of their name ("en — English" is "en"), so the rest of a folder's name can change. Inside each package folder the lessons, Introduction and Resources are found as scripts/check_course.py finds them (numbered lesson folders; Resources is the folder holding the Google Docs and Slides masters); sharedResources means the Resources folder sits next to the package folder and is shared, as for the two Swahili versions. lang picks the app text in course/translations and the language NeuroPocket opens in. NeuroPocket is pinned by hand: to use a newer release, change version and sha256 (the fingerprint of that release's file). The build downloads https://github.com/ousecTic/neuropocket/releases/download/v<version>/<file> and stops if the fingerprint doesn't match.
